name: @piorbit/ui
description: The one web app: Electron renderer, browser tab, and PWA. Speaks @piorbit/protocol over WebSocket. React 19 + Vite + assistant-ui + Tailwind v4 (D-15, D-16). Every browser dependency is a devDependency on purpose: the built bundle in dist/ is the artifact, and nothing imports this package's source at runtime (`exports` offers only package.json, which the host resolves to find dist/). As dependencies they were copied into every installer twice, once inside app.asar and again in app.asar.unpacked, for nothing.
